cohort: 200 pregnant women, 100 with preterm birth (<37 weeks of gestation) and 100 with term birth (>37 weeks of gestation)
finding: Women with preterm birth had lower levels of antioxidants, higher levels of oxidative stress markers, and higher frequencies of DNA damage compared to women with term birth.
gest_age: Preterm birth (<37 weeks), Term birth (>37 weeks)
